newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus threatens to revoke media permits for bias.
newsitem.headline: Belarus threatens to revoke media permits for bias.

text.p: The secretary of President Alexander Lukashenko's powerful Security Council in Belarus on Friday accused foreign and local correspondents of biased reporting and threatened to withdraw their licences to report on the former Soviet republic.

"The Security Council has taken a decision foreseeing a series of steps to defend Belarus's information space, up to the possibility of re-registering local mass media and re-accrediting foreign correspondents," Viktor Sheiman told a rare briefing for local and foreign reporters at the Council.
A Council session headed earlier by Lukashenko had noted "a string of local and foreign mass media report unobjectively on events in Belarus," Sheiman said.
"Many events in the public and political life of Belarus, and the activities of its leadership, are reported extremely unobjectively," he added.
He declined to clarify which mass media organisations in particular were being accused of biased reporting on the country of 10 million on Russia's Western border.
